Job Description: 
 
 DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.
 
 DXC's Insurance Software and BPS (ISB) helps insurers around the world modernize and run their core operations at scale by combining deep industry expertise, proven software platforms, and innovative AI-driven solutions. A global market leader in core insurance platforms, ISB delivers solutions across policy administration, claims, billing, analytics, and digital engagement supporting Life & Annuity, Property & Casualty, and Specialty insurance markets. You’ll directly shape how the world's leading insurers operate by helping to transform the policy, underwriting, and claims systems that millions of people rely on every day.









 
 We are seeking an experienced Senior ServiceNow Platform Engineer to manage, enhance, and optimize the ServiceNow platform across enterprise environments. This role combines platform administration, engineering, automation, integrations, and operational support to ensure a secure, reliable, scalable, and high-performing ServiceNow environment. 
 
 The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow platform administration and a solid understanding of ServiceNow development, JavaScript, integrations, and enterprise IT operations. This position will work closely with infrastructure, cloud, security, networking, and application teams to deliver platform capabilities and continuously improve the ServiceNow ecosystem. 
 
 Approximately 20% of the role will focus on ServiceNow development and automation , with the remaining focus on platform engineering, administration, reliability, and operational excellence. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Administer, maintain, and optimize the ServiceNow platform across development, test, and production environments. 
 Ensure platform availability, stability, security, scalability, and performance through proactive monitoring and administration. 
 Plan and execute ServiceNow upgrades, patches, instance cloning, releases, and environment maintenance. 
 Configure and manage ServiceNow users, groups, roles, access controls, system properties, certificates, and other platform components. 
 Administer and support MID Servers, integrations, and connectivity between ServiceNow and enterprise applications. 
 Monitor platform health and performance, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and implement sustainable solutions. 
 Partner with infrastructure, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, application, and other technology teams to support enterprise integrations and platform initiatives. 
 Support ServiceNow ITSM capabilities and ensure platform configurations align with security, governance, and ServiceNow best practices. 
 Coordinate platform changes, maintenance activities, releases, and disaster recovery processes while minimizing disruption to business operations. 
 Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture standards, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and runbooks. 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain ServiceNow solutions using JavaScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, Flow Designer, and REST/SOAP integrations . 
 Build automation and reusable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve platform efficiency and reliability. 
 Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and internal or third-party systems using REST APIs, SOAP, MID Servers, and other integration technologies. 
 Participate in incident, problem, and root cause analysis activities involving the ServiceNow platform. 
 Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, reliability, automation, security, and user experience. 
 Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance on ServiceNow administration, development, automation, and engineering best practices. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 7+ years of experience in IT, software engineering, platform engineering, or a related technology discipline. 
 3+ years of hands-on experience administering and/or engineering the ServiceNow platform. 
 Strong experience with ServiceNow platform administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and operational support. 
 Experience with ServiceNow upgrades, patches, cloning, releases, instance management, and platform maintenance. 
 Strong understanding of ServiceNow security, roles, ACLs, users, groups, system properties, and platform configuration. 
 Hands-on experience with JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting . 
 Experience with ServiceNow development components such as Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, Flow Designer, and/or related platform capabilities. 
 Experience developing and troubleshooting REST and SOAP integrations and working with APIs. 
 Experience with MID Servers and enterprise system integrations. 
 Strong troubleshooting, debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 Experience working with ITSM processes and enterprise technology environments. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. 
 Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced enterprise environment. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA). 
 ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) or other relevant ServiceNow certifications. 
 Experience with additional ServiceNow modules beyond core ITSM. 
 Experience with ServiceNow IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, or advanced automation capabilities. 
 Experience with cloud platforms and enterprise infrastructure technologies. 
 Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, source control, or automated deployment practices. 
 Experience with performance optimization, platform governance, and enterprise ServiceNow architecture. 
 Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 Experience providing technical leadership or mentoring to other engineers and administrators. 
 
 What You'll Bring 
 A platform engineering mindset focused on reliability, scalability, security, and continuous improvement. 
 The ability to move comfortably between platform administration, troubleshooting, automation, and development. 
 Strong ownership of technical problems from investigation through resolution. 
 A collaborative approach to working with engineers, architects, security professionals, application teams, and business stakeholders. 
 A passion for automation and finding practical ways to eliminate repetitive operational work. 
 The ability to translate complex technical requirements into reliable, maintainable ServiceNow solutions. 
 
 At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

 Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is available   here .
